messages:
Sam L: Quick heads-up — we're doing the API protocol swap next Tue morning (rolling) to retire the old endpoints. Need owners, canary plan, and any blocking deps. Who's taking signal for each slice?
Priya K: I can own SDK bump and consumer-facing changelog. Do we have a compatibility matrix for clients? :thinking_face:
Jorge M: Infra impact question — the proxy config change will require a short restart window. Need ETA on the cutover script and whether we can do zero-downtime reloads.
infra-bot: Scheduled maintenance window: 2026-03-24 02:00-03:00 UTC. Will attempt graceful reloads; fallback plan required.
Sam L: Good call — we should avoid restart if possible. Jorge, can you confirm whether envoy dynamic config is enough? If not, we gate on infra's window.
Jorge M: Envoy dynamic config covers route swaps but not the legacy auth shim. If the shim is removed we need a 2-3 min roll where we run both. I'll draft a small script.
SDK Team: PR #482 (sdk-js) is ready with the client-side toggle and a compatibility test. Failing only on one edge case (multipart responses). Need someone to review and approve.
Priya K: I'll take the review. Also will add a changelog entry and publish a patch after canary looks green. Can you drop a quick diff of the changelog?
SDK Team: Pushed changelog stub to the PR. Command to run local smoke:
```
# run compatibility smoke
npm ci && npm run smoke -- --endpoint=https://staging.redwood.ai/api-new
```
Nina R: For release ops — what's the canary slice? We should reserve 5% traffic for 2 hours, then 25% for 1 hour, then full. Need watchlist: latency, 5xx, token usage per-request.
Sam L: Canary plan sounds good. I'll own metrics during canary. Priya owns SDK release. Jorge owns infra rollback. Nina, can you coordinate the alert thresholds and rollback triggers?
Nina R: Yep. Thresholds proposed: 99.9th latency not exceed +60ms, error rate <0.5% absolute increase, token cost drift <5%. If any trigger hits, immediate rollback to legacy route.
Priya K: One more ask — deprecation banner for customers. Can marketing drop a short note? @marketing-channel? (I'll follow up)
Jorge M: Draft of the shim-run script I mentioned (quick):
```
#!/bin/bash
# shim-run: start legacy auth shim alongside new route
set -e
./legacy-auth &
NEW_PID=$!
# start new route
./route-switch --enable-new
sleep 120
# healthcheck new route
curl -f http://localhost:8080/health || { kill $NEW_PID; exit 1; }
# if health ok, stop legacy
kill $! || true
```
Sam L: Nice. Add logging and a dry-run flag. Also add a feature-flag toggle for customers to opt-in early.
SDK Team: Question: do we need to bump protocol version in server responses? That will break some older clients. We suggest a header x-api-proto: 2.0 and keep body compatible for now.
Priya K: header approach works — SDK will prefer the header and fall back. We'll ship a minor release with parsing for x-api-proto.
Nina R: Ops checklist requests: 1) Canary routing in place, 2) Alerts wired, 3) SDK release queued, 4) Changelog & customer comms, 5) Rollback playbook posted. Can each owner confirm status by EOD?
Sam L: I'll confirm metrics dashboard and add a dashboard link in the playbook.
Priya K: SDK PR: awaiting review (I started). Will cut release after canary green.
Jorge M: I'll post the shim-run repo link and a tested deploy script by EOD PST.
infra-bot: Reminder: create a post-deploy incident channel for the window (auto-created on deploy start).
Sam L: OK — owners: Sam (metrics/canary), Priya (SDK + changelog), Jorge (infra/shim + rollback), Nina (alerts/release ops). If anyone else wants to co-own parts, chime in.
Priya K: Affirmative. Also adding a short test matrix to PR: auth, streaming, multipart, embeddings.
SDK Team: We'll add automated smoke into CI that flips the toggle against staging.
Jorge M: One dependency: eng-infra needs to approve a small firewall rule to allow healthcheck traffic between services. I'll ping infra-owners.
Sam L: Great. If no blockers after 24h we'll proceed to schedule the canary in infra's maintenance window. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
